text:
maria: Hey team — saw a big surge in EU-west yesterday during the config rollout. Queue depth hit ~9k, a bunch of 503s and clients saw >30s tails.
kevin: ugh. did the autoscaler spawn nodes? logs?
maria: Autoscaler did scale but too late. Warm pool size was at 2 per AZ; scale-up cold-starts + container pull time meant GPUs weren't ready in time. infra logs:
```
2026-02-14T20:12:34Z ERROR enqueue: backpressure threshold reached queue=9012
2026-02-14T20:12:35Z WARN autoscaler: scale_up_delay=45s, pending_pods=18
```
arjun: sounds like we need both larger warm pool and admission control. warm pool at 2 is tiny for model rollout spikes.
helen: agree. Also saw fragmentation from spot preemptions — some AZs had little usable capacity so the scheduler waited.
maria: proposed quickfix:
```
# increase warm pool in EU-west
warm_pool:
  min_per_az: 6
  max_total: 30
  image_pull_preload: true
autoscaler:
  scale_up_cooldown: 15s
  burst_limit: 50
```
kevin: can we tie rate limits to available GPU count instead of fixed RPS? i.e. admission control that returns 429 + Retry-After when capacity low.
arjun: yes — use token-bucket with tokens = floor(available_gpus * concurrency_per_gpu). pseudo:
```
allowed_tokens = floor(get_available_gpus() * 4)
if tokens.exhausted -> 429 Retry-After
```
maria: autoscale-bot posted recent metric: https://grafana.redwood/graph?panel=queue_eu
autoscale-bot: alert: eu-west queue >75% capacity for 18m, scale events stalled due to image pull.
helen: we should also pre-warm images (image_pull_preload) and do rolling warm-ups during deploys. schedule: for any model rollout >10% traffic bump, pre-scale warm_pool 10m before.
kevin: cost tradeoff — increasing warm pool will cost ~+12% GPU hours. But better than SLA penalties.
arjun: alternative: admission control + small warm pool bump reduces cost. start with warm_pool min_per_az=4 and implement token-bucket admission control behind the API.
maria: action items:
- increase warm_pool to 4/az (maria) — rollout in 10m
- implement token-bucket admission tied to available_gpus (arjun) — spike canary tomorrow
- add Grafana panel for 'available_gpus' and 'effective_tokens' (helen)
- add alert: autoscale lag >20s AND queue >50% (kevin)
kevin: I'll own the alert. tagging @oncall for visibility.
helen: ok i'll add the dashboard and a runbook entry for warm-pool tuning.
maria: thanks. i'll roll the 4/az change now and monitor. please pause any major deploys to EU for 1h.
kevin: :thumbsup: 
arjun: lgtm.
autoscale-bot: deploy started: warm_pool change applied to eu-west at 2026-02-15T08:03:12Z
maria: monitoring — queue dropping to ~1.2k now, tail latency improving.
kevin: keep an eye for any spot churn.
helen: let's reconvene after 2h to decide on further increases. closing for now.
